seoTitle: Transfer a Domain From Squarespace to WordPress
metaDescription: Move your domain from Squarespace to WordPress for more design flexibility and control, with steps for both platforms.
intro: If you're outgrowing Squarespace's design constraints, moving your domain to WordPress gives you more control through themes, plugins, and custom code. This guide covers the steps on both the Squarespace and WordPress side to get your domain connected.

steps.heading: Set up your WordPress account
steps.body: Log in to WordPress, or create an account if you're new, so you have a destination ready for the domain.

steps.heading: Review your domain in Squarespace
steps.body: In your Squarespace dashboard, click the gear icon, go to Domains & Email, then Domains to see your current domain setup.

steps.heading: Locate or register the domain
steps.body: If the domain is already registered with Squarespace, select it and proceed to checkout to confirm ownership details and registration term.

steps.heading: Follow the transfer prompts
steps.body: After saving, you'll be directed to the registration page — follow the on-screen instructions to move the domain toward WordPress.

steps.heading: Get support if needed
steps.body: Contact Squarespace support or check WordPress.com's guidance if you hit issues connecting or transferring the domain.

faq.question: Why move from Squarespace to WordPress?
faq.answer: WordPress offers more flexibility and customization through themes, plugins, and custom code, and can be more cost-effective for larger or growing sites.

faq.question: Do I lose my domain history when transferring?
faq.answer: A properly completed transfer keeps the domain's registration intact — it's the platform managing it that changes.

faq.question: Can I connect the domain without a full transfer?
faq.answer: Yes, in many cases you can point the domain to WordPress without moving registrars, depending on your setup.

faq.question: What if I get stuck during the process?
faq.answer: Reach out to Squarespace support or WordPress.com for guidance specific to your account.
